!ACC-TP-01
#
vlan 10
 name "Users"
#
vlan 20
 name "Voice"
#
vlan 100
 name "MGMT"
#
hostname "ACC-TP-01"
user name admin privilege admin secret 5 $1$J7K8L9M0$abcdefghijklmnopqrstu/
enable password 7 0822455D0A16
snmp-server community "S3cretRO" read-only "viewDefault"
radius-server host 192.0.2.50 auth-port 1812 acct-port 1813 key 7 0822455D0A16544541
ip dhcp snooping
ip dhcp snooping vlan 10
access-list create 500 name "MGMT-ONLY"
access-list ip 500 rule 1 permit logging disable sip 192.0.2.0 sip-mask 255.255.255.0
access-list ip 500 rule 5 deny logging disable
access-list bind 500 interface vlan 100
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 192.0.2.1
ip route 10.30.0.0 255.255.0.0 192.0.2.1
#
interface gigabitEthernet 1/0/1
  description "PC-101"
  switchport general allowed vlan 10 untagged
  switchport pvid 10
#
interface gigabitEthernet 1/0/25
  description "UPLINK"
  switchport general allowed vlan 10,20,100 tagged
  switchport pvid 100
  ip dhcp snooping trust
#
interface vlan 100
  ip address 192.0.2.40 255.255.255.0
#
end
